item.title: CISA Warns of Critical Unpatched Danfoss RCE Flaw
item.description: CISA warns that a critical, unpatched vulnerability in Danfoss refrigeration controllers could allow attackers to remotely execute malicious code without authentication; CVE-2026-129713.
item.dc:creator: Dark Web Informer

item.title: Google Patches Critical Chrome Remote Code Execution Flaw
item.description: Google has patched a critical Chrome vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute malicious code outside the browser's security sandbox through a specially crafted webpage; CVE-2026-134401.
item.dc:creator: Dark Web Informer

item.title: Europol Traces €26M in Crypto, Disrupts 57 IPTV Services
item.description: Europol disrupts 57 illegal IPTV services and traces over €26 million in cryptocurrency transactions during a coordinated operation involving 11 countries.
item.dc:creator: Dark Web Informer
